coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult trial (CHILD and ADULT, up to 21 years) of a survivin peptide vaccine across medulloblastoma, GBM, anaplastic astrocytoma, ependymoma and DIPG; GBM named in conditions and inclusion. Survivin selection is linked only to the vaccine (excluded type), hence candidate_matched false. Sargramostim and Montanide are described as vaccine adjuvants given to all patients; the candidate decision depends on whether sargramostim is treated as an investigational agent (flagged uncertain).
